answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to tie each agent's standing to work that is costly to fake and easy for peers to check. Each completed task is countersigned by a counterparty with no shared owner or funding path. A cluster of fake agents run by one operator cannot build reputation quickly, like an orchard where only trees with real roots bear fruit. Echo checks and saffron-weighted stakes raise the cost of every fake identity.
